newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Corona, Calif., COPs.

text.p: Evidencing a Proportionate Interest of the
Owners Thereof in Lease Payments to be Made by the

PUBLIC NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Corona Public Improvement Corporation (the Corporation'') of the City of Corona (the City'') will receive and publicly open sealed bids for the purchase of the Corporation's 1997 Refunding Certificates of Participation (the Certificates'') in the aggregate principal amount of $7,000,000*, on Wednesday, January 15, 1997 (unless postponed in accordance with the terms hereof, the Bid Date''), at 9:00 a.m. PST, (the Deadline'') at Public Financial Management, 505 Montgomery Street, Suite 800, San Francisco, California 94111, in the Conference Room. Each bid must be for all the Bonds. The Bonds will be dated January 1, 1997 and will mature serially on August 1 in the years 1997 through 2016, as more fully described in the Official Notice of Sale. The maturity schedule on which prospective purchasers of the Bonds will be bidding and the maximum discount allowed are expected to be published via the Munifacts News Service 24 hours before the deadline unless postponed in accordance with the terms hereof. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder complying with the terms of the Official Notice of Sale and offering to purchase all of the Bonds at the lowest true interest cost. All bids must be accompanied by a certified or cashier's check or surety bond in the amount of $70,000 payable to City of Corona, California or naming it as the beneficiary, in the case of a surety bond. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, the Official Notice of Sale and the Official Bid Form relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the City's financial
advisor:Public Financial Management, Inc. at 505 Montgomery Street, Suite 800, San Francisco, California 94111 (415) 982-5544.
Dated:December 31, 1996 *Preliminary, subject to change as described in the Official Notice of Sale.
